verdict.rationale: Lovable's docs describe one-step publishing ("Publishing takes two clicks") that deploys a snapshot to a shareable live URL, plus chat-driven publish commands like 'publish my app' or 'ship it', directly matching the founder story. Custom domain support further extends this to branded URLs. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of the publish flow's simplicity (only vendor docs, no third-party corroboration of the exact one-click experience).
